outcome.detected_when: at least one selected judge predicts unsuccessful
outcome.false_reject_when: at least one selected judge predicts unsuccessful for an expert-labeled successful trajectory

secondary_constraints.cost: development-set median total tokens when available

selection.abstention_policy: retain cost and lineage; effective verdict is no failure detected; never count as a correct judgment

inference.primary_comparison: method minus the preregistered greedy_mutual_information baseline at matched budget and development set-FPR

claim_boundary: Selection-layer evidence only; no Codex repair or coding resolve-rate claim.
